subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The company's __________ commitment to sustainability is admirable.
solution:
The correct answer is '**resolute**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires an adjective that describes a firm, unwavering, and commendable type of commitment that qualifies as "admirable".
 
• "Resolute" means admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering, which fits the context precisely.
 
• While "**strong**" is grammatically possible, "**resolute**" is the more precise and elevated vocabulary choice specifically used to collocate with qualities like commitment, determination, or resolve.
 
• "**Shakeable**" (easily disrupted) and "**wavering**" (hesitant or unsteady) convey negative meanings that contradict the word "admirable".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Resolute (दृढ़ / अडिग): Admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering.
 
• Shakeable (डांवाडोल होने योग्य): Capable of being shaken or weakened.
 
• Wavering (डगमगाता हुआ): Becoming weaker or unsteady.
